description:
This is an up-to-date fork of GitHub Desktop, with many quality of life improvements and advanced features, including:

• Multi-account support (e.g. two GitHub accounts at once).

• Rich integration with GitHub, Bitbucket, GitLab, Codeberg/Forgejo, and Gitea, including self-hosted instances. Basic git functionality in other platforms.

• Search for commits by title, message, tag, or hash.

• Ability to visualize the commit graph.

• Ability to create several stashes per branch.

• Many small improvements to speed up your workflow, like unpushed branch indicators, and recognizable icons and colors across the UI.

For a full list of added features and improvements, see: https://desktop-plus.org/#feature-list

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
